# Earcut

`earcut.js` is the unmodified Mapbox Earcut 3.0.2 source, used to triangulate
authority polygons (including holes) once for hover/selection highlights.

- Source: https://github.com/mapbox/earcut/tree/v3.0.2
- Original license: `earcut.LICENSE`

It is served locally. No package manager, CDN or runtime network request is used.
